title: Signed: Jodeci Inks With Day After Day for Reunion Tour; ‘Yellowstone’ Singer-Actor Ryan Bingham Joins WME Roster
summary: Other recent artist signings include Day26, Nate Visstick, Outlier, Sam Alfred and The Rat Utopia Experience.
contentText:
R&B group Jodeci signed with Day After Day Productions (DADP) for booking. News of the signing coincided with the group’s announcement of its 36-city 2026 U.S. tour celebrating the 35th anniversary of its hit 1991 debut album Forever My Lady . The run kicks off on Oct. 24 at The Masonic in San Francisco.

Released in September 1991, Forever My Lady was a major success for Jodeci, peaking at No. 18 on the Billboard 200. The album was propelled by the success of the hit single “Come & Talk to Me,” which reached No. 11 on the Billboard Hot 100. Forever was followed by 1993’s Diary of a Mad Band , which peaked at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 and spawned the top 40 singles “Cry for You” and “Feenin’.” Their third studio set, 1995’s The Show, the After Party, the Hotel , debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 and included “Freak’s You,” which peaked at No. 14 on the Hot 100. The group’s biggest hit, a 1993 cover of Stevie Wonder’s “Lately” featured on the album Uptown MTV Unplugged , reached No. 4 on the Hot 100 in August 1993.

Jodeci previously reunited in 2015 for the album The Past, the Present, the Future , released by Epic Records.

For the 35th anniversary of Forever My Lady , UMG re-released the album on July 17 with an expanded vinyl version.

“Thirty-five years ago, Forever My Lady changed our lives,” said K-Ci Hailey and Mr. Dalvin of Jodeci in a joint statement. “The love and connection we share with our fans is unmatched and this tour is for them — the people who stood by us from day one. Get ready, we’re going to leave everything on the stage for you.”

“At DADP, we are incredibly proud and honored to exclusively represent Jodeci and to help bring this monumental tour to life,” said Seth Shomes , founder & CEO of Day After Day Productions. “JODECI is the blueprint for modern R&B and they have influenced countless artists throughout their incredible career. We cannot wait for fans across the country to witness the electricity and magic of this tour.” — Chris Eggertsen
